title: Explanation of Binary Arithmetic
author: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz
description: Introduction of the binary number system using only 0 and 1, with remarks on its utility
rights: Public domain. Leibniz's 1703 French, in Gerhardt's 1863 edition (original/), translated by Enchiridion in 2026 and released with the repository under MIT. Two independent passes, adjudicated; see translation-notes.md. The interlinear shows the French witness beside the English. NOTE: Leibniz.pdf in this directory is Lloyd Strickland's copyrighted 2007 translation, retained as a reference and NOT the text published here; its removal from the tree and history is part of the open source-file question in RIGHTS_AUDIT.md.
